description: Signature Arc silhouette modular starter build in vibrant Tangelo. Featuring high-durability modular sole unit with interchangeable upper mechanism.
Delicate cherry blossom aesthetic meets high-tech modular engineering in the Arc Sakura. Swappable upper with cushioned Arc sole.
Futuristic neon-accented modular sneaker inspired by bio-mechanical techwear. High-contrast modular Arc sole.
Warm earth-toned modular starter sneaker built for all-day urban roaming. Detachable Sand upper on rugged Arc base.
Stealth black-and-white modular sneaker for purists. Premium monochromatic upper locked into our ergonomic Arc sole.
Dynamic gradient aesthetic on the sculpted Carve platform. Bold color interplay with high-rebound modular sole.
Deep burgundy and charcoal accents engineered on the Carve architectural sole. Modular swappable design.
Crimson-forward modular design with aggressive lines and quick-release upper system.
Subtle wasabi green and cream colorway on the Carve modular chassis. Balanced everyday modular style.
High-impact fiery orange accents on charcoal body. Engineered for rugged performance and instant upper swaps.
Crisp ice-blue modular sneaker engineered for clean, technical styling on the flexible Tangent sole.
Natural organic tones on the Tangent modular base. Earthy khaki upper with secure interlocking sole locking tabs.
Lush jade green modular upper paired with off-white Tangent sole unit. Premium modular street look.
Dark tactical aesthetic with gold modular hardware and ultra-durable Tangent grip sole.
Rich caramel and warm biscuit suede modular sneaker. Swap uppers in seconds, keep the sole for life.
High-durability ergonomic Arc replacement sole unit. Compatible with all Arc collection modular uppers.
Sculpted architectural Carve sole unit with shock-absorption heel pod and modular lock-in channels.
Low-profile flexible Tangent street sole with multi-directional tread and snap-fit upper perimeter.
Standalone Tangelo upper kit. Snap onto your existing Arc sole for an instant color transformation.
Standalone Sakura upper kit. Interchangeable upper designed specifically for Arc modular sole chassis.
Standalone Euphoria gradient upper kit for the Carve modular sole system.
Standalone Glacier ice-blue upper kit for Tangent modular soles.
The complete modular initiation pack: Includes 1 Arc Sole Unit + Tangelo Upper + Ikka Upper for two distinct looks.
The Carve Duo pack: Includes 1 Sculpted Carve Sole + Euphoria Upper + Volcano Upper.
The ultimate TESSCH archive collection: 3 distinct sole architectures (Arc, Carve, Tangent) with 5 swappable uppers.
